Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files using AES-256 with unique AES keys per file and RSA-2048 public key encryption of AES keys
Infection via RIG-E exploit kit distribution
Infection through DLL hijacking using legitimate GoogleUpdate.exe executable loading malicious goopdate.dll
File encryption excluding virtual machines and skipping system and common folder names
Ransom note with 72 hour countdown demanding 2.1 bitcoin ransom payment
Discoverer: Proofpoint security researcher and exploit kit expert Kafeine
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with mounted drives and unmapped network shares
Attack Vector: Distribution via RIG-E (Empire) exploit kit through malvertising and compromised websites
Bundled RAR SFX file extracting and executing GoogleUpdate.exe and malicious goopdate.dll
